notes.title: FluidFrames 4.6
notes.content: [p][/p][p]▼ [b]NEW[/b][/p][p][b]AI multithreading[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Is now possible to generate multiple video frames simultaneously [/p][/*][*][p]This option improves video frame-generation performance (up to 8 times faster) [/p][/*][*][p]Can select up to 8 threads (8 frame simultaneously) [/p][/*][*][p]As the number of threads increases, the use of CPU, GPU and RAM memory also increases[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]▼ BUGFIX / IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][p][b]AI Engine Update (v1.22)[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Upgraded from version 1.17 to 1.22 [/p][/*][*][p]Better support for new GPUs (Nvidia 4000/5000, AMD 7000/9000, Intel B500/B700) [/p][/*][*][p]Major optimizations and numerous bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New video frames extraction system[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Introduced a new frame extraction engine based on FFmpeg [/p][/*][*][p]Up to 10x faster thanks to full CPU utilization [/p][/*][*][p]Slight improvement video frames quality[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Upscaled frames save improvements[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Faster saving of frame-generated frames with improved CPU usage[/p][/*][/list][p][b]I/O efficiency improvements[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Disabled Windows Indexer for folders containing video frames [/p][/*][*][p]Significantly reduces unnecessary CPU usage caused by Windows during frame extraction and saving, improving performance in both processes[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General improvements[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Various bug fixes and code cleanup [/p][/*][*][p]Updated dependencies for improved stability and compatibility[/p][/*][/list][p][b]▼ VirusTotal[/b] [/p][list][*][p] [url="https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/35b648fae43998543b58affc8def034b5c96eb6bdcaa82698f11f4d4ab654581"]https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/35b648fae43998543b58affc8def034b5c96eb6bdcaa82698f11f4d4ab654581[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: FluidFrames 4.1
notes.content:
[b]▼ NEW[/b]

[b]Completely redesigned GUI[/b]
⊡ The app now presents file information more clearly
⊡ Many widgets have been repositioned and grouped by functionalities
⊡ All info widgets have been improved, now displaying additional details for each setting
⊡ Redesigned the entire graphical user interface to deliver a modern, intuitive experience

[b]Output resolution widget[/b]
⊡ Added a widget for selecting the output resolution
⊡ Allows upscaling or downscaling after AI processing

[b]Video extension widget[/b]
⊡ Introduced a widget for choosing the output video extension
⊡ Supported extensions:
[b]⊡ .mp4[/b]
[b]⊡ .mkv[/b]
[b]⊡ .avi[/b]
[b]⊡ .mov[/b]

[b]Video codec widget[/b]
⊡ Added a widget for selecting the codec for upscaled videos
⊡ These codecs ensure compatibility with all major GPU families
⊡ Using hardware-accelerated codecs significantly improves encoding speed
⊡ Supported codecs:
[b]⊡ CPU ( x264 - x265 )[/b]
[b]⊡ NVIDIA ( h264_nvenc - hevc_nvenc )[/b]
[b]⊡ AMD ( h264_amf - hevc_amf )[/b]
[b]⊡ Intel ( h264_qsv - hevc_qsv )[/b]

[b]▼ REMOVED[/b]

[b]CPU selection widget[/b]
⊡ The CPU selection widget has been removed
⊡ The app now automatically utilizes the optimal number of CPU cores

[b]▼ BUGFIX / IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[b]AI models update[/b]
⊡ Updated AI models using the latest tools
⊡ Improved GPU compatibility and frame generation performance

[b]General improvements[/b]
⊡ Bug fixes, code cleaning, and overall performance improvements
⊡ Updated dependencies to enhance stability and compatibility

notes.title: FluidFrames 3.12
notes.content:
[b]FIRST STEAM VERSION![/b]

[b]▼ NOTE[/b]

[b]Nvidia GPUs optimizations[/b]
⊡ Is essential to enable Windows Hardware Accelerated GPU scheduling option
⊡ This option can dramatically improve AI performance
⊡ Enable it in Windows 10 / Windows 11 settings > Graphic Settings menu

[b]▼ NEW[/b]

[b]AI models update[/b]
⊡ Updated AI models using updated tools
⊡ Improved performance and improved quality

[b]GPU Auto selection[/b]
⊡ Added new "Auto" option in GPU Widget
⊡ Selecting “Auto,” the app automatically choose the most powerful GPU in the PC
⊡ This solves a problem with GPU processing on notebooks with 2 GPUs

[b]▼ BUGFIX / IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[b]Video Frame Generation improvements[/b]
⊡ Improved video Frame Generation stability and memory usage
⊡ Updated FFMPEG to version 7.1 (video encoding bugfix and performance improvements)

[b]Video encoding improvements[/b]
⊡ Updated MoviePy to version 2.0
⊡ A long list of bugfixes and optimizations for video encoding

[b]General improvements[/b]
⊡ Bug fixes, code cleaning, performance improvements
⊡ Updated dependencies
